title: Execute Stored Procedure on External Database
author: Unknown
content: We created a connection to an external database. The issue is executing a stored procedure on it.
solution_text: You can try executing the command from a rule. For example, as a Dashboard DataSet: Using dbConnApp = BRApi.Database.CreateExternalDbConnInfo(si, 'OneStream BI Blend') then BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConnApp, sqlQ, False)
